@deskLvShellNewsTitle.description: Desktop Overview: title of the one-time notice an install that updated into wallet levels sees. 'Wallet depth' is the setting that picks how much the app shows (levels Shallow, Deeper, Deep end).

deskLvShellNewsText: This install shows everything, as before. Shallow and Deeper show less.

@deskLvShellNewsText.description: Desktop Overview: text of the one-time 'New: wallet depth' notice. Shallow and Deeper are the names of the two quieter levels; keep them as the level picker names them.

@deskLvShellNewsLook.description: Desktop Overview: button on the 'New: wallet depth' notice; opens the page where the level is changed and dismisses the notice.

@deskLvShellFailover.description: Desktop title-bar status popover (Network or Node): row label; whether the wallet moves to another node when its node stops answering.

@deskLvShellOn.description: Desktop status popover: value of the Failover row when the node failover setting is on.

@deskLvShellHeight.description: Desktop Node status popover (Deep end level): row label; the node's block height.

@deskLvShellVersion.description: Desktop Node status popover (Deep end level): row label; the node software's version.

deskLvShellRecheckHint: If an amount looks wrong, the wallet reads the chain again.

@deskLvShellRecheckHint.description: Desktop Settings › This wallet at the Shallow level: info text of the Recheck balance row, whose Open button opens the Recheck balance page.

@deskLvShellSwitchServer.description: Desktop title-bar status popover (Network or Epicbox) at the Shallow level: button that opens a short list of the other servers of the user's list, each named by its address; one click moves the wallet to that server.

deskLvShellNoOtherServer: No other server in the list.

@deskLvShellNoOtherServer.description: Desktop status popover at the Shallow level: shown under Switch server when the user's server list has no server other than the one in use.
